issue: Whether a defendant who did not raise a Rule 12 suppression argument in the district court may still obtain plain error review on appeal.

sides.position: Plain error review remains available for Rule 12 arguments not made before the district court (position not specified in the excerpt).
cases: United States v. Lindsey, 3 F.4th 32 (1st Cir. 2021)
United States v. Reyes, 24 F.4th 1 (1st Cir. 2022)

sides.position: Plain error review is not available for untimely Rule 12 arguments not raised below (position not specified in the excerpt).
cases: United States v. Lindsey, 3 F.4th 32 (1st Cir. 2021)

quote: While there is a circuit split as to whether defendants may still receive plain error review for Rule 12 arguments not made before the district court, see United States v. Lindsey, 3 F.4th 32, 41 n.6 (1st Cir. 2021) (collecting cases), we have recently clarified that in the
cite: United States v. Reyes, 24 F.4th 1 (1st Cir. 2022)
